items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Joe Temperley was born in Cowdenbealth, Scotland in 1929... found a niche for his distinctive baritone sax in the bands of Woody Herman...

ctx.x: Oh it was wonderful. It was really wonderful. And it was a good band. And Woody was going through some bad times because things were rough on the road and Woody was having to deal with income tax problems and some nights he would just say, “I’ll see you all later” and he would dodge out the back because he had this thing about spotting people. He could spot an IRS man coming in the door, and he’d be out the back door and gone.
